newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PRIVATE SECTOR WAS 68 PCT OF 1996 GDP.
newsitem.headline: PRIVATE SECTOR WAS 68 PCT OF 1996 GDP.

text.p: The statistics department said on Tuesday that gross domestic product (GDP) was 31.115 billion litas at current prices in 1996 and that the private sector accounted for 68 percent of last year's economic activity.
The department earlier announced a 3.6 percent rise in 1996 GDP but in a statement today it provided more figures and detail. Total GDP in 1995 grew three percent.
GDP was worth 23.829 billion litas at current prices in 1995 and the private sector then accounted for 65 percent.
Some 53.2 percent of GDP was accounted for by the services sector last year compared to 55.0 percent a year before.
Industrial activity comprised 28.3 percent of GDP in 1996 versus 29.0 percent while the agricultural sector accounted for 11.4 percent of GDP compared to 9.3 percent in 1995.
The construction sector's share of economic activity rose to 7.1 percent of GDP last year versus 6.7 percent.
The department said that all the 1996 figures were still preliminary and would be revised.
The final GDP figure is expected only in September 1997.
